name: The Outer Wardens
flavour: They were guards once, and never really stopped -- the vault doesn't know they're dead, and neither, it seems, do they.

name: The Choir of Bones
flavour: Dozens of throats, one note, held far longer than breath should allow -- because none of them are breathing.

name: The Vault-Keeper
flavour: Still at its post. Still counting whoever comes through the door. The count has been wrong for a very long time.

name: The Outer Palisade
flavour: Sharpened stakes, a rope bridge, and men who know exactly which gaps in the wall to defend. Someone taught them this.

name: The Uncrowned's Right Hand
flavour: Not the one giving the big speeches. The one the big speeches are actually about -- calm, precise, and clearly used to being obeyed.

name: The Uncrowned
flavour: He was a smallholder eighteen months ago, before he lost everything to a goblin with a taste for crowns. Whatever's left of him now doesn't plan on losing twice.
